about-us.description: Aman is designed to provide an interactive learning experience that helps children learn safety skills and how to act correctly during and after emergencies, through educational stories and videos. The platform covers safety topics, basic first aid, and psychological support for children, with interactive questions that reinforce understanding and give instant feedback. It also lets children track their progress, have their performance assessed, and receive a certificate of completion after finishing the educational program, providing a fun and safe learning experience that builds awareness, confidence, and readiness for different situations.
about-us.title: Who We Are

updates.description: Many children lack awareness of safety skills and of how to act correctly during and after emergencies, especially in environments affected by conflict and crisis. Traditional awareness methods are often not age-appropriate or engaging enough. Aman was created to deliver simplified, interactive educational content that helps children gain essential knowledge and skills in a fun and safe way, and strengthens their ability to protect themselves and act confidently in emergencies.

solutions.description: Aman provides an interactive educational solution that helps children learn safety skills and how to act correctly during and after war, through educational videos, interactive stories, and activities based on real-life scenarios. Children learn the basics of first aid, recognize safe behaviors, and receive psychological support in a simplified, age-appropriate way. The platform also includes interactive quizzes, progress tracking, and performance assessment, with a certificate of completion at the end of the educational program, providing a fun and safe learning experience that builds awareness, confidence, and readiness for different situations.

target.description: Aman is designed for children aged 7 to 15. Teachers and parents can also use the platform to support children and strengthen safety concepts in a simple and safe way.

main.description: Providing children with awareness and education about safety principles, how to act correctly during and after emergencies, and the basics of simple first aid, so they can protect themselves and others before rescue teams or the relevant authorities arrive, while strengthening interactive learning with modern technology.
main.sub-description: The principle is to build a generation that is more aware and better prepared to handle emergencies, by developing a culture of safety, strengthening basic first aid skills, and encouraging children to make the right decisions and protect themselves and others, which builds responsibility, confidence, and the ability to respond safely in different circumstances.
